Best Buy Pinole also dropping Sat morning with scanned stock on hand (30th bundles 31, mini tins 31, DR 3-packs 141, Charizard ex 41) — no line reported there yet, likely the better bet vs cooked Target lines. Costco AH tins in transit again per Julia, Lodi selling again Sat unconfirmed.
